figures.title: Chapter map
figures.why: one 1/r² law read three ways - fields, energies, orbits
figures.read: every result is a shell sum, a GM/r energy, or a Kepler exponent

figures.title: The shell theorem: outside a point, inside nothing
figures.why: the most powerful shortcut in the chapter
figures.data: outside g=GM/r²; inside shell g=0; inside sphere g=GMr/R³
figures.read: outside collapse to a point; inside only the mass below you counts

figures.title: Four ways g changes
figures.why: four separate formulas that students blur; keep directions distinct
figures.data: height gR²/(R+h)²; depth g(1-d/R); latitude g-ω²Rcos²λ; spin ~0.3%
figures.read: height dilutes, depth kills linearly, latitude and spin subtract centrifugal

figures.title: Kepler's laws, from the same focus
figures.why: all of orbital motion is three laws; bind them into one picture
figures.data: ellipse at focus; dA/dt constant; T² = 4π²a³/GM
figures.read: the equal-area law is angular-momentum conservation in costume

figures.title: The orbit energy ladder: bind, raise, escape
figures.why: every launch and transfer question is a difference between rungs
figures.read: bound means negative total energy; reaching zero is the escape ticket

figures.title: Triage - route by the keyword
figures.why: the keyword names the route before any number is touched
figures.read: height kills g by the sphere formula, orbits live on GM/r, transfers ride vis-viva
